title: What changed in prediction markets
insights:
- **Kalshi set a new volume record:** On Nov. 21 it traded 5.39B contracts, topping its Nov. 8 high of 5.36B and running 36.6% above its seven-day average of 3.95B.
- **Underdog’s trading accelerated:** Its 186.4M contracts on Nov. 21 were 38.3% above its seven-day average and 76.8% above its 30-day average, at roughly 2.9% of the ten-venue market.
- **ProphetX more than doubled its recent pace:** Nov. 21 volume reached 18.6M contracts, 74.2% above its weekly average and 116.1% above its 30-day average, though it represented about 0.3% of the market.
- **OG/Crypto.com also grew:** Its 154.3M contracts were 20.7% above its weekly average and 60.2% above its 30-day average, with an approximate 2.4% market share.
notes: briefing checks unmet after retry: one bullet must carry Kalshi data from beyond plain volume, normally alongside its headline volume -- taker P&L, fee revenue, settlement accuracy, parlay economics, sports versus non-sports mix, or an unusually large trade -- for the latest reported day or the past week against a recent baseline, never an all-time or months-old cumulative total; the Kalshi bullet is not backed by a query over a Kalshi depth table -- run one instead of satisfying the requirement with a general parlay, sports, or monthly-share phrase; on Kalshi's record day its bullet never says which part of the market carried the 5.39B contracts -- add sports, parlays or whichever segment did, from that same day, sized against the day's total

evidence.label: Additional context 2
evidence.sql:
WITH venue_rows AS (
    SELECT
        CASE platform
            WHEN 'Polymarket_US' THEN 'Polymarket US'
            WHEN 'Crypto.com/Nadex' THEN 'OG/Crypto.com'
            ELSE platform
        END AS venue,
        date,
        contracts
    FROM competitor_daily
    WHERE platform <> 'Kalshi'
      AND COALESCE(complete, TRUE) = TRUE

    UNION ALL

    SELECT 'ProphetX' AS venue, date, contracts
    FROM prophetx_daily
    WHERE COALESCE(complete, TRUE) = TRUE
),
latest_dates AS (
    SELECT venue, MAX(date) AS latest_date
    FROM venue_rows
    GROUP BY venue
),
latest_volume AS (
    SELECT r.venue, r.date, r.contracts
    FROM venue_rows r
    JOIN latest_dates d
      ON r.venue = d.venue
     AND r.date = d.latest_date
),
recent_history AS (
    SELECT
        r.venue,
        COUNT(*) AS days_in_window,
        AVG(r.contracts) AS avg_contracts_prior_30_days,
        MAX(r.contracts) AS max_contracts_prior_30_days
    FROM venue_rows r
    JOIN latest_dates d
      ON r.venue = d.venue
     AND r.date >= d.latest_date - INTERVAL 30 DAY
     AND r.date < d.latest_date
    GROUP BY r.venue
)
SELECT
    l.venue,
    l.date AS report_date,
    l.contracts AS latest_contracts,
    h.days_in_window,
    h.avg_contracts_prior_30_days,
    100.0 * (l.contracts / NULLIF(h.avg_contracts_prior_30_days, 0) - 1) AS pct_change_vs_prior_30_day_average,
    h.max_contracts_prior_30_days
FROM latest_volume l
LEFT JOIN recent_history h USING (venue)
ORDER BY pct_change_vs_prior_30_day_average DESC;

anchor.question: Build the anchor table for today's Predict Charts industry briefing. For each prediction-market venue, use its latest complete reported day and return venue, report date, reported contract volume, the average of its prior seven complete reported days, and percent change versus that average. Use daily_overall for Kalshi and exclude rows where is_partial is true. Use competitor_daily only for platforms other than Kalshi, add ProphetX from prophetx_daily, and add CME from cme_daily. Never use competitor_daily's Kalshi row; it is not the authoritative Kalshi total. In competitor_daily the `complete` column is only populated for Polymarket_US and is NULL for every other platform, where NULL means the row IS complete. Filter it as COALESCE(complete, TRUE) or omit the filter entirely; never write `complete = TRUE`, which silently discards every platform whose flag is NULL. Exclude partial days. CME is the sparse bulletin series; a normal seven-day lookback spanning seven calendar days is regular, not sparse. Resolve the latest complete reported day SEPARATELY FOR EACH VENUE. Do not filter the whole result to one shared calendar date, and do not require a venue to have a row on the newest date any venue reported: a venue whose most recent complete day is a few days old is reporting normally and still belongs in the table, on its own date. Each venue's prior-seven-day baseline is its own prior seven REPORTED days, which for an irregular reporter spans more than seven calendar days. Every one of these ten venues must appear in the result: Kalshi, Polymarket US, ForecastEx, DKeX, Underdog Exchange, OG/Crypto.com, ProphetX, Novig, Rothera, CME. OG/Crypto.com is the platform stored as 'Crypto.com/Nadex'.
anchor.sql:
WITH venue_rows AS (
    SELECT 'Kalshi' AS venue, date, contracts_total AS volume
    FROM daily_overall
    WHERE COALESCE(is_partial, FALSE) = FALSE

    UNION ALL

    SELECT CASE platform
               WHEN 'Polymarket_US' THEN 'Polymarket US'
               WHEN 'Crypto.com/Nadex' THEN 'OG/Crypto.com'
               ELSE platform
           END AS venue,
           date,
           contracts AS volume
    FROM competitor_daily
    WHERE platform <> 'Kalshi'
      AND COALESCE(complete, TRUE) = TRUE

    UNION ALL

    SELECT 'ProphetX' AS venue, date, contracts AS volume
    FROM prophetx_daily
    WHERE COALESCE(complete, TRUE) = TRUE

    UNION ALL

    SELECT 'CME' AS venue, date, cme_total_vol AS volume
    FROM cme_daily
),
ranked AS (
    SELECT
        venue,
        date,
        volume,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY venue ORDER BY date DESC) AS day_rank
    FROM venue_rows
),
summary AS (
    SELECT
        venue,
        MAX(date) FILTER (WHERE day_rank = 1) AS report_date,
        MAX(volume) FILTER (WHERE day_rank = 1) AS reported_contract_volume,
        AVG(volume) FILTER (WHERE day_rank BETWEEN 2 AND 8) AS prior_seven_day_average
    FROM ranked
    GROUP BY venue
)
SELECT
    venue,
    report_date,
    reported_contract_volume,
    prior_seven_day_average,
    (reported_contract_volume / NULLIF(prior_seven_day_average, 0) - 1) * 100
        AS percent_change_vs_prior_seven
FROM summary
ORDER BY venue;
